prompt:
Write a TypeScript module (strict mode, Node 24, `lib` set to `esnext`) that exports two functions over tag sets. Neither may modify its inputs.

- `diffTags(before: ReadonlySet<string>, after: ReadonlySet<string>): { added: Set<string>; removed: Set<string>; kept: Set<string> }` -- `added` holds the tags in `after` but not in `before`, `removed` those in `before` but not in `after`, and `kept` those in both. All three are newly created `Set`s (never one of the arguments), even when the inputs are equal or the same object.
- `jaccard(a: ReadonlySet<string>, b: ReadonlySet<string>): number` -- the Jaccard similarity: the size of the intersection divided by the size of the union. Two empty sets have similarity `1`.

Answer with a single ```ts code block.
